'''Those Who Dwell Beyond the Veil''' were [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Deity/Legends|deities]]. They may have been early space travelers. The Aing-Tii claimed that it was these deities who taught them the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
